definitions.gloss: liquid India ink, bottled sumi ink
definitions.explanation: Pre-made liquid ink used for calligraphy (書道) and ink painting (水墨画). A convenient alternative to grinding an ink stick on an inkstone.

examples.japanese: {墨汁|ぼくじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧につけた。
examples.english: I dipped the brush in the ink.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{墨汁|ぼくじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: We use liquid ink in calligraphy class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{墨汁|ぼくじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついてしまい、⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{落|お}ちなかった→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: I got ink on my clothes and it wouldn't come out even after washing.

notes:
Pre-made liquid ink used for ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧ (calligraphy) and ⟦{水墨画|すいぼくが}→水墨画：27810_suibokuga⟧ (ink painting). A convenient modern alternative to the traditional method of grinding ink.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese schools, students use {墨汁|ぼくじゅう} in ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧ class. Traditionally, ink was prepared by grinding an ⟦{墨|すみ}→墨：02155_sumi⟧ (ink stick) on a ⟦{硯|すずり}→硯：06124_suzuri⟧ (inkstone) with water, but bottled {墨汁|ぼくじゅう} is far more convenient and is standard today.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {墨汁|ぼくじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to apply ink (to a brush)
- {墨汁|ぼくじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こぼれる→こぼれる：02105_koboreru⟧: the ink spills
- {墨汁|ぼくじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧しみ: an ink stain

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{墨|すみ}→墨：02155_sumi⟧: ink stick (traditional solid form)
- ⟦{硯|すずり}→硯：06124_suzuri⟧: inkstone
